Hi Tanya / AtlasCloud team,

Attaching the acceptance checklist and a draft tenant cutover runbook for the Private VPC deployment targeted for the week of 2026-12-20. We want to run a dry cutover on 12/18 and a final cutover on 12/20. Please review the attached artifacts and call out any blockers by EOD Monday (2026-12-13) so we can lock the schedule.

Key asks:
- Confirm the egress/NAT approach in section 3 of the checklist (we currently show single NAT gateway per tenant with optional SNAT to shared egress).
- Confirm KMS/HSM envelope key ownership model for customer-managed keys (section 5).
- Validate the topology diagram (attached PNG) against your colo configs and peering plan (BGP ASN, ACLs).

Attachments: vpc-acceptance-checklist.xlsx, tenant-cutover-runbook.md, private-vpc-topology-v2.png

High-level acceptance gates we expect to clear before the dry run:
- Tenant VPCs provisioned and subnet mapping validated
- Control-plane access (operator VPN + certs) confirmed
- KV cache persistence and backup for inference nodes verified
- Audit logs flowing to AtlasCloud SIEM (retention window agreed)

If easier, we can run a 30m walkthrough tomorrow.

Thanks,

On Fri, Dec 11, 2026 at 08:14 AM Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Tanya / AtlasCloud team,
> 
> Attaching the acceptance checklist and a draft tenant cutover runbook for the Private VPC deployment targeted for the week of 2026-12-20.

Thanks Connor — reviewed the checklist and runbook at a high level. A couple of clarifying questions before we sign off: 

1) Egress / NAT: our colo team prefers single egress IP per tenant only for breakout to public services that require allowlisting. For other traffic we'd prefer hairpin through our shared egress proxy (we can provide the proxy FQDNs). Can Redwood support mixed-mode egress per-tenant (SNAT + proxy) without changing the model?

2) KMS/HSM: we need to confirm whether Redwood will call our KMS via customer-managed IAM roles or if Redwood expects a delegated key. Our security team requires a proof of concept for envelope encryption flow (we can host a short demo).

3) Audit logs: AtlasCloud needs at least 12 months of immutable audit retention (S3 Glacier-like). Does the current checklist map to that retention policy or only 90 days?

I've attached a lightly annotated topology PNG with a note on BGP ASN and two ACLs that need confirmation. If you can point us to the specific runbook step that handles the dry-run rollback (we couldn't find rollback step id in the MD), that would help.

Attaching: private-vpc-topology-v2.png (annotated)

—Tanya

On Sat, Dec 12, 2026 at 10:22 AM Tanya Singh <tanya@atlascloud.com> wrote:
> Thanks Connor — reviewed the checklist and runbook at a high level. A couple of clarifying questions before we sign off: 
> 
> 1) Egress / NAT...

Great questions — answered inline and updated the checklist/runbook in the attached spreadsheet and MD. Summary: 

- Mixed-mode egress is supported. We will implement per-tenant routing rules so customer traffic to allowlisted services uses a dedicated SNAT IP while general outbound traffic is routed to the shared egress proxy. That behavior is optionally configurable per-tenant in the tenant profile (see checklist row A7).
- KMS/HSM: Redwood will integrate with AtlasCloud KMS via customer-provisioned IAM role and endpoint (no delegated key by Redwood). We will document the envelope encryption handshake in the runbook (new section 5.2) and schedule the POC with your security team — proposed slot Wednesday 2026-12-16 10:00 PT.
- Audit retention: checklist now includes a mapped retention policy. We can support immutable 12 month retention by exporting audit logs to AtlasCloud-managed archival storage; the runbook notes the export job (cron) and verification steps.

Rollback/dry-run: I added an explicit rollback play (runbook step R3) that covers traffic switchback, cache invalidation, and cert revoke/renew cadence. Dry-run checklist also includes a traffic validation step and a 1-hour observation window before final cutover.

I've uploaded the updated files to the Drive link Connor shared and attached the updated checklist locally.

Next steps from our side:
- Confirm POC time 12/16 with Tanya
- Karthik to validate the BGP ASN/ACL mapping (Karthik — can you confirm before EOD 12/14?)

Thanks,
